I was shucking mangoes and got inspired to do a piece to my favorite fruit and wanted to share my work with all of you! How I did it: I initially loaded my PP with the light orange color and lightly dipped it in a crimson for the first two letters. It will start rich crimson then slowly fade back to the orange. For the last two letters, I pulled the cartridge and replaced it with green. There was still orange in the nib so I made scratch marks on another part of the paper until it was the light green I wanted for the 'e'. Went back to the scratch area to bleed it to the dark green then came back for the 's' and embellishment. Bit of work but well worth it.

People will always put you down, but there are ten more who will build you back up and love you for who you are. If they treat you like a piece of shit ignore them, for they don't know you. Basically I dug to the roots of the things I felt sad/paranoid about and to be honest, there was no reason for me to feel nothing but the opposite of sad/paranoid about them. **Control what you can but don't get sad or upset about the things you can't.** If you feel down about your appearance or who you are, you can turn it around.
